source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Starting with the signal connector, the proposed assignments are:
J\_PWR\_SIGNAL — JST-GH 1.25mm 7-pin:
Pin 1: SDA0
Pin 2: SCL0
Pin 3: IRQ
Pin 4: PWRON
Pin 5: D+
Pin 6: D-
Pin 7: 5V\_EN

For the power connector, use:
J\_PWR\_POWER — JST-PH 2.0mm 4-pin:
Pin 1: 3V3
Pin 2: GND
Pin 3: 5V
Pin 4: GND (5V return)

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Choose whichever pin order best suits your layout, but ensure the main board connector uses that same order. Once you send me your preferred arrangement, I'll revise the docs accordingly.

value_updates.power_connector_pin_order_policy: Choose the order that best suits the layout and use the identical physical order on the power-board and main-board connectors.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: On J\_PWR\_PWR (4-pin JST-PH), does pin 1 physically correspond to 5V or GND? To prevent the cable from creating a short, I need the main board to use matching numbering.

ambiguity.description: The physical pin-1 assignment for the 4-pin interboard power connector is unresolved, while matching numbering across the power and main boards is required to avoid a short.
